title: Restart authorization weaker than cancel: any org member can restart another user's run
description: The cancel route restricts to run owner OR org admin (lines 185-191), but the restart route only calls checkOrgMember, so any non-owner org member can restart (and thereby re-attribute) a run they do not own.

title: status query param coerced to WorkflowRunStatus without validation
description: req.query.status is cast directly to WorkflowRunStatus[] (options.statuses = [status as WorkflowRunStatus]) with no check against the allowed enum ('queued'|'running'|'cancelling'|'completed'|'failed'|'cancelled'|'paused'), so an invalid status string is passed unchecked into listWorkflowRuns.

title: Non-positive / out-of-range limit not rejected
description: limit is only guarded by !isNaN(limit); a negative or zero limit (e.g. ?limit=-5) passes the check and is forwarded to listWorkflowRuns without bounds validation.

title: inputs not validated as an object
description: inputs is read from req.body and forwarded as inputs ?? {} (line 61) without verifying it is a plain object, so a client sending inputs as an array, string, or number passes it unchecked into orchestrator.startRun.
